newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony leaps to new high on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Sony leaps to new high on earnings hopes.

text.p: Sony Corp shares leapt to a new record high on Tuesday morning as investors continued to buy them on hopes that its first-quarter earnings would be robust, brokers said.
As of 0038 GMT, the shares were up 200 yen at 11,500, after briefly touching a high of 11,600 soon after the market opened.

"Trading for August delivery started today and dealers are joining in," a trader at a foreign brokerage said. "The share price is moving actively, which is another reason which is encouraging for dealers."

Analysts say Sony is likely to report a 30 to 60 percent rise in operating profits for the first quarter from April to June. In May, the electronics giant surprised the market by announcing a 160 percent jump in group net profits for the last business year to March 1997.
The earnings are due be announced on July 31.
